requirements.title: EVENT_TYPE has private extensible derived-type properties and default initialization
requirements.source: S16.10.2.10 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF473.
requirements.definition: EVENT_TYPE is a derived type with private components, is extensible with no type parameters, and each nonallocatable component is fully default-initialized.

requirements.title: EVENT_TYPE event variables have event-count semantics
requirements.source: S16.10.2.10 p2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF473.
requirements.definition: A scalar EVENT_TYPE variable is an event variable whose value includes an event count updated by EVENT POST or EVENT WAIT as by ATOMIC_ADD; EVENT_TYPE coarrays have unordered segment reference permissions; the event count has integer kind ATOMIC_INT_KIND and initial value zero.

pending.event-count-atomic-int-kind-initial-zero: Out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision: the event count is a private event variable component tied to EVENT_TYPE coarray semantics.

requirements.title: EVENT_TYPE named entities are variables and components are data components
requirements.definition: A named entity with declared type EVENT_TYPE, or with a noncoarray potential subobject component of declared type EVENT_TYPE, shall be a variable; a component of such a type shall be a data component.

requirements.definition: An event variable shall not appear in a variable definition context except as the event-variable in EVENT POST or EVENT WAIT, as an allocate-object, or as an actual argument associated with an INTENT(INOUT) dummy argument in a procedure with an explicit interface.
